drivingQuestion: What practical difference is there between R' Akiva and R' Yehoshua?
outcomeNote: The answer lies beyond this unit.

segments.he: אָמַר רַבִּי עֲקִיבָא: אֲנִי לֹא בָּאתִי לִידֵי מִדָּה זוֹ, אֶלָּא כֹּל שֶׁיָּדוּעַ כּוּ׳. מַאי אִיכָּא בֵּין רַבִּי עֲקִיבָא לְרַבִּי יְהוֹשֻׁעַ?
segments.en: The baraita taught that «Rabbi Akiva says: I have not arrived at this method» of determining firstborn status. «Rather,» in «any» case «where it is known» the animal had previously given birth, the priest has nothing here. And in any case where it is known the animal had not previously given birth, its firstborn is given to the priest. And if it is uncertain, it may be eaten in its blemished state by the owner. The Gemara asks: «What» difference «is there» in practice «between» the opinions of «Rabbi Akiva and Rabbi Yehoshua?»
